messages:
maria_g: quick sync — we need to settle per-route accounting for launch. customers are asking how function calls, structured output, and embeddings batching count vs. a plain chat request.

devin: agree. can we define an MVP billing schema? A couple customers hit unexpected bills during an internal canary when tool chains returned lots of tokens.

alex.s: short proposal: split token accounting into buckets in the response: `billing_tokens_total`, `billing_tokens_model`, `billing_tokens_tools`, `billing_tokens_structure`. that way we can attribute cost to model vs. tool/formatting overhead.

lia_prod: +1 to explicit buckets. product question: do we expose those in the public API responses or only surface in Console/usage UI? legal will want clear contract.

maria_g: public API preferred (customers asked), but vets needed. MVP: include fields in response metadata but behind a feature flag for GA customers. then show in Console for everyone.

pm-bot: reminder: rollout checklist item created -> PRD-502: per-route billing fields + telemetry dashboards.

alex.s: example minimal response shape I had in mind:```json
{
  \"id\": \"resp_abc\",
  \"route_id\": \"chat.conversation.v1\",
  \"billing_tokens_total\": 1254,
  \"billing_tokens_model\": 980,
  \"billing_tokens_tools\": 210,
  \"billing_tokens_structure\": 64
}
```

tim_ops: small nit — we should include `model_variant` and `quantization_profile` on the record so routing/cost anomalies are debuggable.

devin: important edgecase: embeddings batch calls. We currently charge per-embedding unit; but batched payloads have both per-request overhead and per-embedding units. need clear formula: `charge = max(per_request_min, sum(embedding_units)) + per_embedding_unit * N`.

maria_g: yep. AND document how retries/tooling that do multiple forward passes count. Example: a tool that calls the model twice for post-processing — both passes count. customers get surprised.

lia_prod: launch criteria suggestion: 1) API returns token buckets, 2) Console shows per-route breakdown for 30d, 3) telemetry queries for top-50 customers implemented, 4) docs + migration guide published.

alex.s: for rate limits: we should separate three concepts — steady quotas (tokens/minute), burst allowance (short window burst tokens), and concurrent request caps. per-route defaults can be stricter than global. e.g., embeddings route: high throughput but lower burst per-customer.

devin: implementation ask from infra: need a single canonical attribution key per request: `route_id|route_hash` so both billing and SLO infra use same dimension.

maria_g: action: we need to pick which fields go in MVP schema. my lean: `billing_tokens_total`, `billing_tokens_model`, `route_id`, `model_variant`, `billing_pricing_tier` (string), and `billing_request_kind` (chat|embedding|rerank|function). everything else (tools/structure) v1 opt-in.

lia_prod: can we compromise and include `billing_tokens_tools` as opt-in flag for customers who enable `detailed_billing=true`? that keeps default small and legally safe.

alex.s: OK. implementation plan: wire the runtime to emit per-component counters; API layer aggregates into the response fields; feature flag gates detailed fields. infra to store new counters in event stream.

pm-bot: note: owners needed: infra -> @tim_ops, runtime -> @alex.s, api -> @devin, product doc -> @lia_prod.

tim_ops: timeline reality check: infra event schema change + storage + dashboards ~ 3 sprints. can we scope rollout as: internal canary (week 1), GA with feature flag (week 3), default on for new tenants (week 6)?

maria_g: sounds reasonable. otto customer ask: they need guaranteed per-route burst for weekend batch jobs. we should formalize SLA-ish burst contracts as an add-on in Dedicated.

lia_prod: good call — add a 'burst_contracts' doc page for Dedicated customers, include example SLAs and pricing.

devin: one more API contract edge: function/tool calls that return structured JSON with long keys can inflate `billing_tokens_structure`. we should include a recommendation in SDKs to compress field names or return token-compact formats.

alex.s: also, we must list prohibited billing hacks: e.g., artificially duplicating requests to circumvent per-request min. enforcement via server-side dedupe ids? maybe just document and monitor.

maria_g: OK folks, final ask: please comment on the MVP field set by EOD. I'll collate and send PRD update. we need sign-off from legal and sales before enabling in public API.

lia_prod: noted, will add sales/legal review checkpoint.

tim_ops: will prep infra impact doc by tomorrow.

devin: I'll prototype API response changes and the feature flag toggle in staging.

alex.s: will add runtime counters and small integration test that validates the buckets sum to total.

maria_g: thanks — if anyone has example customer logs that illustrate surprising bill spikes, drop them here. that'll help shape default mins/bursts. :thumbsup:
